notes.title: First look at Pilgrims: Curious Adventures, our debut board game!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/015eb5d4fa29343d563c9b24d7890a880ca0dc79.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Hello, travelers![/h3][p]We’re excited to share a closer look at [i][b]Pilgrims: Curious Adventures[/b][/i], our very first board game developed in collaboration with our friends at Pink Troubadour. It’s inspired by the whimsical world of our video game [i]Pilgrims[/i], but instead of doing a one-to-one adaptation, we brewed up something new: a highly replayable, easy-to-learn yet deeply tactical tabletop adventure. Our goal was to keep the charm and playfulness of the original while creating mechanics that feel right at home on your table.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/6a8e368614393471df5ded29b54d0fff36614612.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/e8cc374d614f13f034232d9d4b2a41e285233a27.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/d9fbef7a5abe87fe202b441b60a6e7c78345024b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/cec7d84286676d59ba06e9e77e876259fbb494cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/efc02573860b1f5b9f81a52e7c0e1f79acc88f0a.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]In [i]Pilg[/i]rims:[i] Curious Adventures[/i], you can compete with up to three friends or even venture out solo. You’ll wander across an ever-changing map of cards to recruit companions and collect useful items. Combine movement and collected cards in thoughtful, puzzle-like ways to trigger special abilities and complete adventures to earn points and party improvements. As your party grows stronger, so do the possibilities for clever tactics and combos.[/p][p]In a [url="https://www.riseher.cz/rozhovor-radim-jurda/"]recent interview[/url] for Riseher.cz, designer and illustrator Radim Jurda (lead designer and artist on [i]Creaks[/i]) shares how a small card prototype grew into a full-fledged board game, how he balanced a playful atmosphere with strategic gameplay, and what it’s been like to bring Amanita’s signature style into a new medium. You can read the entire [b]interview in English[/b] now on [url="https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/16617/blogpost/177505/radim-jurda-on-his-new-board-game-and-personal-sty"]BoardGameGeek[/url].[/p][p][i]Pilgrims: Curious Adventures[/i] will make its debut this October at Essen SPIEL 2025, the world’s largest board game fair. The English edition will launch this fall, with pre-orders opening in late September on Amanita Design’s [url="https://merch.amanita-design.net/"][u]online shop[/u][/url]. A Czech edition is planned for 2026. Stay tuned, we’ll share pre-order details and other news here on Steam![/p][p]Wishlist [i]Pilgrims: Curious Adventures[/i] on BoardGameGeek, where you'll also find the game's [url="https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/305465/pilgrims-rulebook"]rulebook[/url]:[/p][p][url="https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/444683/pilgrims-curious-adventures"]https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/444683/pilgrims-curious-adventures[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]BONUS PICTURES: A fresh look at the wooden meeple! [/b]ːmuchomurkaː[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/4158596a120d0bb52782d4518671e84f8c51ad54.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/50c68fc5229de0e150e0beda55d2dbd0f10a21aa.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p]

notes.title: OUT NOW: Creaks - Bonus, Live & Remixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/65a9f49a16fb4c42f94b7584750fa982de5b1a77.png[/img]

The new album "Creaks: Bonus, Live & Remixes" is now available for streaming and download! If you're an owner of the Creaks Soundtrack DLC here on Steam, please check out its download folder - an mp3 version of the album is waiting there for you ːcreakskissː Still we'd like to encourage you to support Hidden Orchestra directly if you enjoy their music - [url=https://hiddenorchestra.bandcamp.com/album/creaks-bonus-live-remixes]Bandcamp[/url] is a good place for that! And you'll also find it on all your favorite spotifies etc.

The record brings seven previously-unreleased tracks from the original soundtrack, plus two extensively reimagined live band versions, and seven remixes from a very diverse set of artists including Floex and Ben Lukas Boysen, all interspersed to create an adventurous yet cohesive new album. 

Once you're done listening, don't forget to let us know about your favorite tracks in the comments!

notes.title: Happy Game from Amanita Design is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/ccc47750267479cde341aac8abd40aabb4f57d6c.png[/img]

The latest Amanita Design game has just landed on Steam! 

It’s Happy Game, our darkest, creepiest, and most twisted adventure so far, coming from the team behind Botanicula and CHUCHEL.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206060/Happy_Game/

Happy Game is an absurd horror adventure game designed by Jaromír Plachý, who previously brought you the family-friendly games Botanicula and CHUCHEL. This time, however, Jaromír decided to make something a little less cheerful, and the result of his team’s work is a psychedelic journey through a little boy’s three horrible nightmares, each with its own style, creatures and puzzles.

Get in the proper mood with the very happy launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=u7XQpAKqB7s;full][/previewyoutube]

Once again, we’re very happy to have worked with our favorite Czech music duo DVA, who created all of the spooky sounds and music for Happy Game. The original soundtrack is also available to purchase on Steam and is coming later to streaming services as well.

Please note: Happy Game is not a happy game.

notes.title: Make Your New Neighbours! (Creaks Fan Art Contest)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/fbfd5ddd9e096cff3e5b5b3bc7cb90a9ca5f302b.png[/img]

🖌️ It’s fan-art contest time! 🎨

Creaks is having its first anniversary this month and it's time to celebrate it with you with a little fan art contest. Here's a personal invitation video from the designers of Creaks, Radim Jurda and Jan Chlup!

Creaks are the deadly monsters that lurk in the dark corners of our houses. But once you trap them under a beam of light, they transform into a harmless everyday object - a piece of furniture, a music instrument or maybe a piece of modern technology? You’ve already met a few of them in our game, but now it’s up to you to use your imagination and design your own Creak!

Every Creak has two forms - one that won’t hurt you, and one that you don’t want to touch. Your task is to design a new Creak in both forms and put them into one picture. Will you design your own complete level, or would you rather make a little comic strip? Is it going to be a very dangerous Creak, or just a misunderstood supernatural being? Use any tools or techniques you want - there are no limits to your imagination!

We encourage you to be creative. Please do not copy others’ ideas, and do not copy characters from the game. 

You can submit your works starting today until July 29 using the submission form below. Please fill in as many details as you can, so we can properly tag you.
https://forms.gle/uxmFiyahEz8E7phBA

[previewyoutube=zrGa0sehXWs;full][/previewyoutube]

Once we’ve gathered all your works, we’ll take a week to carefully consider which we like the best. After we go through all the submissions, we will make a selection of semifinalists. Then we will ask the Discord community to vote and select the Discord Community Award. At the same time Radim and Jan will choose 5 more winners. The final winners will be announced on August 10. We're looking forward to seeing your work!

Prizes:
1st: ‘Creaks Collector’s Box’ + ‘Creaks 2LP’ + ‘Creaks T-Shirt’
2nd: ‘The Art of Creaks’ + ‘Creaks T-Shirt’ + ‘Creaks 2LP’
3rd: ‘The Art of Creaks’ + ‘Creaks T-Shirt’ + ‘Creaks 2LP’
4th: ‘The Art of Creaks’
5th: ‘The Art of Creaks’

Discord Community Award: ‘Creaks Collector’s Box’ + ‘Creaks 2LP’ + ‘Creaks T-Shirt’

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/Gr4Ec6K

notes.title: Creaks Collector's Box and The Art of Creaks are now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/0924878c87afc9598af30bafe8d5b4b45d56402d.jpg[/img]

After several months of hard work, we're happy to let you know that both [b]Creaks Collector's Box[/b] and [b]The Art of Creaks[/b] are finally shipping worldwide!

The [b][url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/frontpage/products/creaks-collectors-edition]Collector's Box[/url][/b] is limited to [b]1000 hand-numbered units[/b], each delivered with a certificate of authenticity signed by the game's authors Radim Jurda and Jan Chlup. notes.title: First Look at 'The Art of Creaks' Deluxe Art Book, and more
notes.notes:
Did anybody ask for an art book? Vinyl? T-shirts? Collector's edition?

Well, if you did ask about either of those things, here's some good news - we've got something for you! For the past few months, we've been working on a bunch of physical items to accompany Creaks, and it's about time to introduce them to you. Let's start with the latest stuff!

[h2]The Art of Creaks[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/59f863d1f55be486489e6dc7290ce2e681e047dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/767026459df40a6f1dd4e9bb9014058faaa1af20.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/48fd481241ee607abf370fa3bf75073ebfb3266a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/3b28aef344af5ce0edca4773400c22b7c4dfea5b.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/5516721d14a619066e6c9ebcf6c2ec092db77413.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/f7b731781ad1f089bd19e5e76cbc2d9a39f6d378.jpg[/img][/url]

Fresh out of the printer, this is '[b]The Art of Creaks[/b]', a new deluxe art book featuring concept art, sketches, design concepts, final visuals as well as insight from the creators on 180 pages of quality paper. The format is 27x27 cm square, and the English version is available for pre-order via our [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/creaks/products/the-art-of-creaks]merch store[/url]. This one starts shipping next week!

[h2]Creaks Collector's Box[/h2] (Limited to 1000 units)

notes.title: Someone should make a game about: chimneys
notes.notes:
My grandmother had a chimney in her house, and all the rituals that went with it. All week she would set aside time for the making of spills - little concertinas of newspaper that were good for getting fires going. She would keep an eye on the log pile, and if any of us had an orange, we would save the peel for her to toss into the flames when the fire was lit. This last part I remember so strongly that I still find myself holding onto orange peel for a few seconds whenever I'm eating an orange, before I remember that my grandmother died in 1991. Anyway, the rituals extended to the fire itself. She would stare into the flames and, in fact, through the flames. The sooty back wall of the fireplace would become home to little orange embers that would advance up and down as the fire progressed and she liked to watch them.

Someone should make a game about chimneys. But hearths? That's really what my grandmother's rituals were all about, and somebody has made a game about hearths already. Little Inferno is a game about buying stuff to burn it, and I can take the thudding heft of its satire because the game is so beautiful when it comes to the details. You are presented with a hearth and you chuck things in. You move the fire around with a mouse or a finger. Woomf! Delicious.

But what about chimneys? The flue and the, the rest of it? Is that the chimney? Where does the flue end? Is the flue the whole thing? Confusion reigns.

notes.title: Mark your calendar - Creaks is releasing on Steam next Wednesday
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/6a4830ae77a2ab5d7541ea7dfbbde21b4f581f0a.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

The long-awaited news is finally here - Creaks, our latest surreal puzzler, is launching on Steam next Wednesday, July 22!

Creaks takes you on a visit to a mysterious towering mansion, inhabited by eccentric avian folk and strange creatures, which may or may not be as dangerous as they seem. In their animated form, these monsters called creaks are deadly enemies you should always keep your distance from. However, as soon as you manage to trap them under a beam of light, they transform into harmless furniture that might be just as useful when you’re solving many of the game’s elaborate puzzles. Players will meet several types of creaks in the game, and each of them behaves differently - while dogs will chase you on sight and spies will copy or mirror your movement, the jellyfish-like creatures composedly patrol the area.

[previewyoutube=YgBaf3onLWs;full][/previewyoutube]

Inbetween individual levels and challenges, players will get to explore the house for a series of hand-crafted paintings, some of which were carefully hidden in discoverable secret rooms. About a third of the 35 collectible pieces are playable mini-games, taking on the role of little arcade cabinets in the aesthetic of 18th and 19th-century wall art.

A game inspired by the topics of ambiguity and pareidolia - the psychological phenomenon of “seeing things” - Creaks aims to surprise players with its diverse surreal environments, hand-drawn, hand-painted, and carefully animated, as well as refined puzzles. The visual art goes hand-in-hand with music from Brighton-based composer and multi-instrumentalist Joe Acheson, aka Hidden Orchestra. He delivered an eclectic score that adaptively changes based on your progression within each of the game’s levels and often drops the beat to celebrate the moment you finally figure it out. Instruments Joe used on this soundtrack, his first-ever work for a video game, are ranging from zithers and flutes to organs and choirs to modular synthesizers.

Sorry to keep you waiting so long! ːmuchomurkaː
Lukas
